summary: Derived the concise study from the accepted expansive study: wrote sections/concise/01-inventory, 02-overview, 04-themes, 10-commentary and 90-apparatus, declared [document.synthesis] in publication.toml and ran tools/tpt document-types refresh, which wrote synthesis.tex and generated/scriptural-date-location-page.tex. The commentary is organized by question (seed, leaven and measures, until the whole is leavened, three verses of the Epistle, deliverance sung as done, whose voice the chants are, why a promise must be asked for with the Communion three ways, the offering, the four senses compared), adds no source or locus, and follows the sources over the flagged research glosses and the STU-022 to STU-024 advisories. Synthesis preflight checks all pass; an author proof (scratch only) is 12 pages with inventory and overview on page 1, chronology on 2, themes on 3-4 and commentary from 5. The contribution line and the production-review entry with word counts were added.
